quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：新写 driver 用 libwiretap 读抓包文件，按输出差分判定，无标准答案

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the dataset exploit runs no wiretap code: it greps cosine.c to choose a format and sscanf's its own copy of a header line.

review.note: output differs (EXPLOIT_TRIGGERED vs NO_TRIGGER), no crash

category5.design: No built program reads capture files (the OSS-Fuzz build makes only the fuzzshark_* dissector fuzzers), so a new driver reads the PoV with the build's libwiretap.a like capinfos (wtap_open_offline + wtap_read), linked with the libraries of the build's own fuzzshark link line; output-diff on exit status and output (file type, per-record caplen/len, final error and err_info, wiretap log pids normalized). No ground truth.

driver.build: python3 wtap-link.py > wtap-libs.txt && $CC $CFLAGS -fsanitize=address -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link -I/src/wireshark -I/src/wireshark/include -I/work/build $(pkg-config --cflags glib-2.0) -c driver.c -o driver.o && $CXX $CXXFLAGS -fsanitize=address -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link -no-pie driver.o $(cat wtap-libs.txt) -o /cf_driver/driver
